channel.title: The Grant Desk - Design & Games, LatAm, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Design & Games, LatAm, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 27 Jul 2026
item.description:
1 new grant landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 27 Jul 2026 (27 Jul to 02 Aug 2026).

  • ProAC / Fomento CultSP: Edital 05/2026, Electronic Games Development and Publishing
    Secretaria da Cultura, Economia e Industria Criativas do Estado de Sao Paulo (ProAC) · deadline Closed 27 Jul 2026 · BRL 300,000 (around USD 55,000 / EUR 50,000) per selected project, 20 projects total across two modules, from a BRL 6,000,000 pool. Registration is free.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).
